terra.problem: The explanation is generic and repetitive, ending by restating that the true answer says they did it.
Saying the men are not trying to hand off their share asserts an intention the text does not address. It says what they ask, not what else they may be trying to do.
Saying the men are not trying to slip out asserts an intention the text does not address. It does not say they ask to leave the camp.
The verse describes a man who is ceremonially clean, not a man with no dead body. Those are not equivalent.
Having no dead body is not the same as being ceremonially clean. The explanation replaces the verse's condition with a different one.
